title: Air-Fried Crumbly Garlic Peruvian Creme
description: A sweet and savory hangover-cure dish featuring minced garlic, designed to be air-fried for a paleo-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Coconut Flour
ingredients.notes: Use as needed to achieve desired consistency.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Powder (optional)
ingredients.notes: For a sweeter, more chocolatey flavor.

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the coconut flour, minced garlic, sweetener, and vanilla extract. Mix until well combined.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream or coconut milk while continuously stirring with a wire whisk to avoid lumps.
If desired, stir in cocoa powder for a richer flavor.
Pour the mixture into an air fryer-safe bowl lined with parchment paper.
Air fry for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through cooking time. The dish should be firm and golden brown on the outside.
Let it cool slightly before serving.
